(i) it is possible to improve the performance of Bayesian optimisation by extracting a small set of domain specific knowledge, (ii) this knowledge can be expressed in an intuitive and declarative manner, and (iii) it is possible for a system engineer to implement an auto-tuner for their system with a small amount of effort.
